books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.description: A lone envoy encounters a world whose social life challenges his assumptions about gender, loyalty, and political trust.

books.title: Kindred
books.description: A modern writer is repeatedly pulled into the antebellum past and forced into a dangerous relationship with her own family history.

books.title: The Master and Margarita
books.description: A fantastical satire in which the devil arrives in Moscow while a parallel story returns to ancient Jerusalem.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.description: A gifted young mage must repair the harm caused by his pride and face the shadow he released into the world.

books.title: The Dispossessed
books.description: A physicist crosses between two divided societies, testing the promises and failures of both political systems.

books.title: The Dawn of Everything
books.description: A wide-ranging re-examination of common stories about early cities, hierarchy, freedom, and the origins of inequality.

books.title: Theory and Reality
books.description: An accessible map of twentieth-century philosophy of science, from logical empiricism to realism and social studies of science.

books.title: The Odyssey
books.description: An epic of homecoming, endurance, identity, and the consequences of a long war.

books.title: The Name of the Rose
books.description: A medieval murder investigation unfolds inside a labyrinthine abbey shaped by theology, politics, and books.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.description: On a geologically unstable world, three interwoven lives reveal the human cost of power, oppression, and survival.

books.title: Moby-Dick
books.description: A sailor joins Captain Ahab's obsessive hunt for a white whale.
